REGULAR MEETING OF THE PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make an inquiry concerning the item.Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on the City’s website under Parklands Committee Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.
The Parklands Committee, at the direction of the Committee Chair with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda. Note: Agenda topics may be continued to future Parklands Committee meetings.
The Parklands Committee welcomes and encourages public participation at the Committee meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to AB 361 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's recommended measures to promote social distancing. All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed; however, the meeting will be recorded and made available on the City's website. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83411783128
Zoom Meeting ID: 834 1178 3128
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 834 1178 3128
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to participate under COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC or on any item of interest on the Agenda by simply utilizing the "Raise Hand" feature during the item under consideration. When called upon to speak please state your name for the record. All speakers will receive 3 minutes to speak during public comment or on the item indicated. Members of the public are not required to submit notification in advance. If you wish to show any visual aids while you speak during the meeting, you may submit a PDF version (maximum 20 slides) no later than 12:00 PM (Noon) on May 12, 2022 to cmoritz@pvestates.org

MEMORANDUM
  Agenda Item #: 4
  Meeting Date: 6/14/2022

 TO:  CITY COUNCIL
 FROM:  ANASTASIA SEIMS, PUBLIC WORKS DIRECTOR
  CARL MORITZ, URBAN FORESTER
 SUBJECT:  PARKLANDS COMMITTEE ACTIONS OF MAY 12, 2022 MEETING
 DATE:  MAY 12, 2022

CALL TO ORDER The meeting was called to order at 6:30 pm.
ROLL CALL:

Present: Committee Members Rossick, Nye, Cooper, McCabe
Absent: Committee Member Rhodes

Also Present: City Manager Prestwich, Public Works Director Seims, Urban Forester Moritz

APPROVAL OF AGENDA Moved by Vice Chair Cooper and seconded by Committee Member
Nye to approve the agenda as presented. The motion unanimously carried by the following vote:
AYES: ROSSICK, NYE COOPER, MCCABE
NOES: NONE
ABSENT: Rhodes

INTRODUCTION: Introduction of Public Works Director Anastasia Seims

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

Julie McCown addressed the Committee

CITIZEN APPLICATIONS

1. PC-561-22; Application to remove four Aleppo pine trees, one Canary Island pine tree, and
  three Olive trees located in the parkways adjacent to 1252, 1256, 1260, 1300, 1305, 1309,
  and 1313 Via Romero.

  Applicant: John Weick, 1309 Via Romero, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

ACTION: Moved by Committee Member Rossick, and seconded by Vice-Chair Cooper, to
approve staff’s recommendation to (1) remove Aleppo pine number 2 and the Canary Island pine
number 5 with trimming of the remaining Aleppo pines to thin and elevate the low branches to

May 12, 2022, Parklands Committee Actions  Page 1 of 3
  City of Palos Verdes Estates
 improve the view; (2) approve the trimming of the Olive trees to reduce the height by five feet
and approve a no-fee permit for regular maintenance after the first trimming; and (3) require a
$500 payment to the ‘Tree Bank’ for each tree not required to be replaced, removal of the two
stumps and a tree removal/topping permit the first year. The motion died for a lack of majority
on the following roll call vote:
AYES: Rossick, Cooper
NOES: Nye, McCabe
ABSENT: Rhodes

ACTION: Moved by Nye, seconded by Cooper, to approve staff’s recommendation except not
allow removal of Aleppo pine number 2 or the Canary Island pine number 5. The motion
unanimously carried by the following roll call vote:
AYES: Rossick, Nye, Cooper, McCabe
NOES: None
ABSENT: Rhodes

2. PC-560-22; Application to remove two Brazilian Pepper trees located in the parkway adjacent
  to 2515 and 2517 Novato Road.

  Applicant: Kenley Jansen c/o Charles Petersen Esq., 734 Silver Spur Road, Ste. 312, Rolling
  Hills Estates, CA 90274

ACTION: Moved by Committee Member Nye, and seconded by Vice Chair Cooper, to approve
the removal of both Brazilian pepper trees; require stump removal and a Tree Removal Permit;
and rather than payment to the tree bank, require the applicant to plant four (4) Strawberry trees
in consultation with the Urban Forester; and maintain the Strawberry trees for two years.
AYES: Rossick, Nye, Cooper, McCabe
NOES: None
ABSENT: Rhodes

3. PC-563-22; Application to remove one Peruvian Pepper tree located in the Parklands
  adjacent to 1609 and 1605 Via Barcelona.

  Applicant: Mort Rowghani, PO Box 3712, Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274

ACTION: Moved by Vice Chair Cooper to deny the application to remove the tree and the
applicant pay to have the tree trimmed. The motion died for a lack of second.

Moved by Committee Member Nye, and seconded by Vice Chair Cooper, to deny the removal
of the Peruvian Pepper tree and require the applicant pay to have the tree trimmed under
direction of the Urban Forester. The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote:
AYES: Rossick, Nye, Cooper, McCabe
NOES: None
ABSENT: Rhodes

May 12, 2022, Parklands Committee Actions  Page 2 of 3
  City of Palos Verdes Estates
 4. PC-564-22; Application to remove one Eucalyptus tree located in the parkway adjacent to
  2709/13 Via Elevado.

  Applicant: Jeffrey Carberry, 2716 Via Elevado, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

ACTION: Moved by Vice Chair Cooper to deny the application to remove the tree and the
applicant pay to have the tree trimmed. The motion died for a lack of second.

Moved by Committee Member Rossick, and seconded by Committee Member Cooper to
approve staff’s recommendation to trim the tree to elevate the lower branches and thin the
density of the canopy but not approve topping; and approve a no-fee tree trimming permit for
annual trimming after the first trim. The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
AYES: Rossick, Nye, Cooper, McCabe
NOES: None
ABSENT: Rhodes
